general.title: Single-cell QC review
general.instructions: Checks cell quality in a single-cell store. Start with just the input store: you get a report and a qc_decisions.json in /results. Tweak that file if needed, attach it, run again to preview, then switch mode to apply to save the passing cells. Your input is never changed.

categories.name: 1. Data (start here)
categories.help_text: First time? Just fill in the input store and hit run.

categories.name: 2. Save the passing cells
categories.description: Once you're happy with the report
categories.help_text: Set mode to **apply** and pick the `qc_decisions.json` from your last report run. It won't run if you edited that file since, if new samples came in, or if any sample is still pending.

categories.name: 3. Advanced
categories.help_text: The defaults match stores made by the ingest capsule.

parameters.name: Input store
parameters.help_text: e.g. `/data/atlas` (icechunk, local or `s3://bucket/prefix`) or `/data/atlas.zarr`. A SpatialData `.zarr` works too: its cell table gets checked. Only read, never changed.

parameters.name: Decisions file
parameters.help_text: Leave empty the first time. Later, edit the `qc_decisions.json` a run gave you, attach it, and pick it here.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: report = just look, apply = save the passing cells

parameters.name: Save to
parameters.help_text: Empty = branch `qc` for icechunk, or `/results/<input>.qc.zarr` for a .zarr input. Apply always writes a copy, never the input.

parameters.name: Writable origin
parameters.description: s3:// path behind a read-only icechunk data asset
parameters.help_text: Only needed to apply to an icechunk store attached as a data asset.

parameters.name: Reviewer
parameters.description: your name, saved with the curation (optional)

parameters.name: Per-cell-type QC
parameters.description: extra tables and plots per cell type

parameters.name: Compute missing metrics
parameters.description: for stores without QC columns (slow: reads all counts)
